cases.title: Audio quality issues - one-way audio and mid-call audio drop
cases.findings:
**Example 1 (Albania +355694812005):**
- UUID: 4318d212-1bb6-11f1-bd45-02420aef94a0
- Duration: 118 sec | MOS: 4.49 | Quality: 98.4%
- B2BUA: b2bua-canary.tel-lv1-prox-prod-610
- Root Cause: SIP re-INVITE at 1:09 caused brief audio disruption
- Verdict: No Telnyx-side issue

**Example 2 (Georgia +995322044044):**
- UUID: e1987bfe-1c56-11f1-8074-02420aef8d1f
- SIP Call-ID: 785cf9677397f4ec774cc5133aa6d472@sip-trunks-euc1.cloudtalk.io
- Time: 2026-03-10 07:58:09 UTC
- B2BUA: tel-nj1-prox-prod-654 (canary)
- Carrier: DeutscheTelecom (194.25.206.x)
- Inbound MOS: 4.49 ✓ | Outbound MOS: 1.0 ✗
- Root Cause: Media path asymmetry - RTP not returning from carrier

**Example 3 (Georgia +995322044044):**
- UUID: 899724a6-1c55-11f1-a5a6-02420aef8e1f
- SIP Call-ID: 337b67bf2454f02705b8817a0b252cfa@sip-trunks-euc1.cloudtalk.io
- Time: 2026-03-10 07:48:32 UTC
- B2BUA: tel-nj1-prox-prod-654 (canary)
- Carrier: DeutscheTelecom (194.25.206.x)
- Inbound MOS: 4.49 ✓ | Outbound MOS: 1.0 ✗
- Root Cause: Same as Ex 2 - outbound leg showing zero RTP packets

**Conclusion:** Customer-side NOT at fault. Georgia routing via DeutscheTelecom vendor has systematic media path issue.
cases.notes:
TREAT Analysis Complete:
- Ex 2: http://treat.query.prod.telnyx.io:4000/?rtc-id=785cf9677397f4ec774cc5133aa6d472%40sip-trunks-euc1.cloudtalk.io
- Ex 3: http://treat.query.prod.telnyx.io:4000/?rtc-id=337b67bf2454f02705b8817a0b252cfa%40sip-trunks-euc1.cloudtalk.io

Both Georgia calls routed via same B2BUA (tel-nj1-prox-prod-654) and same carrier (DeutscheTelecom). Issue is systematic on Georgia route.

Escalated to carrier team for investigation.
cases.response: Customer notified that Ex 1 (Albania) was a session timer refresh issue. Ex 2 & 3 (Georgia) identified as carrier-side media path issue - escalated to carrier team for investigation of DeutscheTelecom Georgia routing.
